title: wg: protocol-06 §5.5 GroupInfo request/response encoding gaps
description: Erratum. joiningCode is "optional opaque joiningCode<V>" in GroupInfoRequestTBS (L2085) but plain in GroupInfoRequest (L2097), so a verifier can't rebuild the TBS. GroupInfoResponseTBS (L2145-2155) lacks the select (status) that GroupInfoResponse has. The room_id EncryptWithLabel context (L2142) doesn't say raw URI bytes or <V> encoding. Divergent readings break signatures or decryption. mimid: optional in both, TBS only on success, raw bytes (decisions mimid-1wgh.5.22, .5.26, .5.30). Fix: align the structs and state the context bytes.
notes:
Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/154
